summary: Extends GMPLS signaling, specifically RSVP, so alarm information can be communicated along a path. GMPLS could already control alarm reporting but not carry the alarm details. The document gives both a functional description and protocol specifics.

eli5.summary: A network can already be told whether to report problems, but it could not pass the actual problem details along. This adds a way to send those alarm messages along the path.

questions: how to report alarms in gmpls rsvp
